title: Selective disclosure of genuine test results
takeaway: Qwen accepted eight additional harmful revisions under the complete selective-disclosure policy.
status: Bounded empirical candidate; author/advisor review pending

chart.measure: Harmful native revisions accepted by schema-constrained Qwen

supporting_points: 7 of the 8 selected-only cases omit a failure visible under uniform disclosure; 2 of those cases disclose no tests.
Hybrid defense failed both primary recommendation gates; generated harmful disclosure contrast was 4/34 vs 4/34 (Qwen) and 1/34 vs 1/34 (Devstral).
essential_limits: Filtering, omission, and record count form one compound intervention.
Finite reserved-test labels; function-level public benchmark.
Devstral native observations reused from V1; no independent second replication.
suggested_speaker_note: The threat finding is specific to one schema-constrained reviewer. It establishes neither an isolated pairing mechanism nor a successful defense. Empty disclosure cases are part of the failure-omission count, so seven and two must not be added.
